name: Scottish Economic Society Annual Conference 2027
call_type: Papers (oral or poster) and organised sessions
deadline_note: "Paper submission closes on Tuesday 3 November 2026." Organised-session deadline not stated. Note: scotecon.org home page shows the dates as '12th April to 14th April 2026 at the University of Glasgow' (apparently stale); the conference site states Heriot-Watt University, 12-14 April 2027.
submission_requirements: Full manuscript with 250-word abstract (preferred) or extended abstract of max. 750 words entered in the portal; only one paper per presenting author; choose oral or poster format at submission (posters offered for the first time in 2027)
registration_fee: Members: GBP 375 early (until 14 Jan 2027) / GBP 475 standard; PhD student members GBP 200 / GBP 250. Non-members: GBP 412 and GBP 512 (early/standard not labelled); PhD student non-members GBP 220 and GBP 270
keynotes: John Van Reenen (LSE) - President's Invited Lecture; Sir Partha Dasgupta (Cambridge) - Adam Smith Lecture; Swati Dhingra (Bank of England MPC) - Policy Keynote Address
